Name: Smol Fish
Author: stevethebeave
Description:
There are lots of comprehensive "easy fishing" mods, but this one only does one thing: prevents fish from escaping.

Installation: simply place the [font=Courier New]SmolFish [/font]folder into your Stardew Valley installations's [font=Courier New]Mods [/font]folder

You still need to catch the fish by filling up the bar (or cancel the minigame if you can't!), but your progress will not fall below a certain level.

The minimum catch progress defaults to 5%, but can be configured in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] or via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

Setting the value to 100% will cause the fish to be caught instantly, effectively turning this into an auto-catching mod.

Setting it to 0% will allow fish to escape normally, effectively disabling the mod.

Downloads.Description: Simple no-escape fishing mod, updated to work on 1.6
